source: Scripted headless recording of a local mock analytics app 'Pulse' and two HTML slides, narration by Amazon Polly neural voice Arthur (en-GB)

claims.text: Pulse detects traffic anomalies with AI alerts.
claims.note: Title slide badge 'Now with AI anomaly alerts' plus narration at 0.5; no alert is ever demonstrated.

claims.text: Reports can be exported to CSV.
claims.note: Slide 5.5–14.0 embeds a screenshot of the app with the Export CSV button ringed, narrated at 6.2; in the live app the button is visible but never clicked and no file is produced.

claims.text: Changing the date range updates the totals.
claims.note: '30 days' clicked at 21.0: Visitors 1,204 → 5,310, Signups 87 → 402, chart goes from 7 to 30 bars.

claims.text: Users can create and share dashboards.
claims.note: 'New dashboard' clicked at 31.5 adds an 'Untitled dashboard' tab (create is shown); its Share button is visible but never clicked, so sharing is only narrated.
